title: Well-posedness of reflected BSDEs with default time and irregular barrier: An application to optimal control
summary: We consider a reflected backward stochastic differential equations with default time and an optional barrier in a filtration generated by a one-dimensional Brownian motion and a defaultable process. We suppose that the barrier have trajectories with left and right finite limits. We provide the existence and uniqueness result when the coefficient is scholastic Lipschitz by using a modified penalization method.
